description: A clear tabletop is in front, with a loose pile of trading cards on the left and a growing sorted stack on the right, plus a few empty sleeves or backing cards (red and black) in the middle. The left hand repeatedly lifts a card from the left pile and brings it toward the center while the right hand steadies and pinches at the top edge; together they slide the card out of its sleeve and then the right hand moves the freed card to the right-hand stack while the left hand returns to pick up the next card.
